The same jar, eleven prices

No single channel is cheapest on everything. These are the eleven Korean beauty retailers behind this catalog — what each one carries, and how often it comes out lowest when the prices are lined up side by side.

How the prices get here

Pipeline

The collector checks each channel's robots.txt and terms before it starts, and prefers a public API wherever one exists. Two concurrent requests per channel, 1.2 seconds apart. Everything it returns is public listing data — no logins, no member-only pricing.

This is a portfolio snapshot. The products, prices and stores on this page are a demo dataset modelled on real Korean retail listings and price bands — they are not live quotes. Check the store before buying. The working collector ships alongside this page in the scraper/ directory.
01

Channel adapters

One adapter per store. Public product API where there is one, otherwise the category pagination.

02

Normalisation

Brand spellings drift across stores, so a dictionary settles them. Volume, SPF and pack count are pulled out of the name into their own fields.

03

Matching

Brand plus normalised name plus volume forms the key; leftovers are grouped by string similarity. One product ends up carrying several store prices.

04

Attribute tagging

Age, gender, category and concern keywords are lifted out of the description and ingredient list. Those tags feed the concierge.

05

Scoring

Age fit 18 points, gender 14, category 22, preference 14, then adjusted by rating, review count and anything over budget.
